items.q: 'Out the Window,' 'John's Idea,' 'Swinging the Blues,' We had a thing called 'Daisy Chain,' all those heads, you know.

ctx.x: So there was no music in the band and I told him one night -- I put in my notice. I said I'd had it, you know. And he said, 'What is this?' I said, 'I really want to, you know, learn how to read very good. I want to be a very -- I want to be a good musician, you know. And you take Ed Lewis and all those guys that had been in Benny Moten's band, they had been playing the same thing.
